Parameters.DKP: Distance between the prime mover centre line and the front axle king pin.
Parameters.DT: Distance between the king pin and the outside edge of the front tyre.
Parameters.FO: Front overhang of vehicle unit, i.e. distance from the front axle (or articulation point) to the front of the body.
Parameters.W: Half the width of the vehicle unit.
Parameters.TR: Distance from the vehicle centre line to the outside edge of the tyres on the rear axle group.
Parameters.LR: Distance from the front axle (or articulation point) to the rear of the body.
Parameters.LT: Distance from the front axle (or articulation point) to the trailer attachment point. May be given as zero for the last vehicle unit.
Parameters.LA: Distance from the front axle (or articulation point) to the first (leading) rear axle of the vehicle unit.
Parameters.DA1: Distance between the first and second rear axles (give as zero if only one rear axle).
Parameters.DA2: Distance between the second and third rear axles (give as zero if only one or two rear axles).
Parameters.DA3: Distance between the third and fourth rear axles (give as zero if only one, two or three rear axles).
Parameters.TS1: Total stiffness of tyres used on the first rear axle in kg/rad.
Parameters.TS2: Total stiffness of tyres used on the second rear axle in kg/rad (give as zero if only one rear axle).
Parameters.TS3: Total stiffness of tyres used on the third rear axle in kg/rad (give as zero if only one or two rear axles).
Parameters.TS4: Total stiffness of tyres used on the fourth rear axle in kg/rad (give as zero if only one, two or three rear axles).
Parameters.AL1: Axle load for the first rear axle in kg.
Parameters.AL2: Axle load for the second rear axle in kg (give as zero if only one rear axle).
Parameters.AL3: Axle load for the third rear axle in kg (give as zero if only one or two rear axles).
Parameters.AL4: Axle load for the fourth rear axle in kg (give as zero if only one, two or three rear axles).
Parameters.MTA: Maximum trailer angle to avoid jack knifing.
Parameters.FTC: Count of all tyres for front axle
Parameters.FTS: Spacing between tyres for front axle.
Parameters.ATC1: Count of all tyres for first rear axle.
Parameters.ATD1: Diameter of all tyres for first rear axle.
Parameters.ATW1: Width of all tyres for first rear axle.
Parameters.ATS1: Spacing between tyres for first rear axle.
Parameters.ATC2: Count of all tyres for second rear axle.
Parameters.ATD2: Diameter of all tyres for second rear axle.
Parameters.ATW2: Width of all tyres for second rear axle.
Parameters.ATS2: Spacing between tyres for second rear axle.
Parameters.ATC3: Count of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATD3: Diameter of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATW3: Width of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATS3: Spacing between tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATC4: Count of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATD4: Diameter of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATW4: Width of all tyres for third rear axle.
Parameters.ATS4: Spacing between tyres for third rear axle.
